reply.text: That one is for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't weigh in on whether to go in or wait. If the ankle is swollen, you can't put weight on it, or it's getting worse, getting it looked at is the right call. Once a clinician has cleared you for training, tell me what they said and I'll build the work around it, and we can keep your general training on track in the meantime.
